sources.title: Clinical evaluation of software (MDR Art. 61 / MDCG 2020-1)
sources.why: Requires proving the software performs in its target population, the core check against data and clinical-rule bias.

sources.title: IVDR — in-vitro diagnostic software (Regulation (EU) 2017/746)
sources.why: Mandates validity and clinical performance evaluation so biased interpretation rules on specimen data are detected and corrected.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Provides quality dimensions to self-assess non-device health software, including the reliability of its data-driven rules.
